# Assemble

Source: [`Kernel/Assemble.wl`](../../Kernel/Assemble.wl) · Design notes: [MODULES.md](../MODULES.md#assemble-kernelassemblewl--assembleequations)

AssembleEquations: the declared equations in compact form, written in scale-stripped atoms generated from the propagator atoms (replaces the hand-written toAtoms/atomVals of DE4plus\_fast.wl), then in explicit form with the derived d\_s R. Objective, assumptions and checks: docs/MODULES.md section "Assemble".

## Symbols

### `AssembleEquations`

`AssembleEquations[closure]` writes every declared equation d\_s(comb) = RHS in compact form (scale-stripped atoms `ScaleAtom[...]`, abstract dsR) and in explicit form ("Integrand": the loop q-integrand in the couplings, `dsCoupling[...]`, the shapes r(q^2/k^2) and their derivatives, Dim). Returns the "Equations" stage.

### `ScaleAtom`

`ScaleAtom[a, b, m, j]` is a scale-stripped atom of the compact equations: `GammaAtom[a, b, m]`(s) = scale(s) `ScaleAtom[a, b, m, 0]`, and its j-th s-derivative = (scale without s) `ScaleAtom[a, b, m, j]`; the scale is the common factor (number, couplings, power of s) of the terms of the atom. Explicit values: the "Atoms" key of the Equations stage.

### `ShowEquation`

`ShowEquation[equations, comb]` prints d\_s(comb) = RHS in compact form, the atoms it uses and the validity conditions.

### `EquationOf`

`EquationOf[equations, comb]` is the equation record whose flowing combination is comb.
